videos.title: Mass Magnetics: USA-made magnetics for robotics and defense
videos.summary:
Magnets are becoming critical to the future of robotics, defense, and other major US industries.

But 90% of rare earth magnet material is conventionally thrown away.

The team at Mass Magnetics are recycling magnets from old EV motors into new ones, with the goal of making American magnets at scale
